description: IFrame Embed widget. Embeds an external URL inside the dashboard. The sandbox attribute is always rendered (empty string = fully locked down). Only http(s)/relative URLs embed; other schemes render a blocked-embed fallback.

url.description: URL to embed. Supports template expressions. Canonical runtime field.

src.description: Legacy alias of url (frontend renders url ?? src).

allowScripts.description: Allow script execution. Persisted default true for saved-content compatibility.

allowForms.description: Allow form submission. Persisted default true for saved-content compatibility.

height.description: Frame height in px or CSS value

sandbox.description: Legacy raw HTML sandbox attribute value (space-separated tokens). Capability toggles take precedence when set.
